title: Read File Record single-group request
purpose: Exercise a deeper parser entry using a valid file-record style request body with one sub-request group under correct Modbus/TCP framing.
expected_behavior: Server decodes function 0x14 and parses one file-record group from the request body. If the addressed file, record, and length are supported, it returns a normal Read File Record response; otherwise it may return an exception response.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0x0009 matches unit id plus 8-byte PDU
Function 0x14 selected from documented function catalog
File-record request body completed conservatively as one grouped sub-request with internal byte-count consistency
Canonical byte ordering maintained for reference type and 16-bit fields
Valid PK-only parser-depth seed without intentional corruption
issue_safety_notes: No vulnerability payloads used. File-record body is a safe structural analogue intended for parser coverage, not malformed stress.
